2.text: “Mbese umunyampaka yagisha Ishoborabyose impaka?Ugayisha Imana nasubize.”

4.text: “Dore ndi insuzugurwa, nagusubiza iki?Nifashe ku munwa.

5.text: Navuze rimwe ariko sinzongera gusubiza,Ndetse kabiri ariko sinakongera.”

6.text: Maze Uwiteka asubiriza Yobu muri serwakira ati

8.text: Mbese ugiye kumvuguruza icyo nategetse?Ugiye kumpererezaho ibyaha kugira ngo ubone urubanza?

9.text: Harya uhwanije n'Imana amaboko?Wabasha guhindisha ijwi nka yo?

10.text: Noneho rimbana ikuzo no kwifata neza,Kandi wiyambike icyubahiro n'ubwiza.

11.text: Sandaza uburakari bwawe busesekare,Kandi witegereze umwibone wese umucishe bugufi.

12.text: Urebe umwiraririzi umuzitse acogore,Kandi ukandagirire abanyabyaha aho bari.

13.text: Bose ubashyire mu mukungugu,Mu maso habo uhakingiranire mu bwihisho.

14.text: Ni bwo nzakwemera,Yuko ukuboko kwawe kw'iburyo kubasha kugukiza.

15.text: Nuko witegereze Behemoti iyo naremye nkawe,Irya ubwatsi nk'inka.

16.text: Dore itegereze imbaraga zayo ziri mu matako yayo,N'ububasha bwayo buri mu mitsi y'inda yayo.

17.text: Izunguza umurizo wayo nk'umwerezi,Imitsi yo mu matako yayo irasobekeranye.

18.text: Amagufwa yayo ameze nk'imiheha y'umuringa,Amaguru yayo ameze nk'ibihindizo by'ibyuma.

19.text: “Mu byaremwe n'Imana ni yo ngenzi,Umuremyi wayo ni we watinyuka kuyegera yitwaje inkota.

20.text: Ni ukuri imisozi iyibera urwuri,Aho inyamaswa zose zo mu ishyamba zikinira.

21.text: Yiryamira munsi y'ibiti bifite ibicucu,Mu bwihisho bwo mu rufunzo no mu nkuka.

22.text: Ibiti bifite ibicucu biyikwizaho ibicucu byabyo,Igakikizwa n'imikingo yo ku mugezi.

23.text: Dore iyo umugezi wuzuye ntiruha ihinda umushyitsi,Naho Yorodani yakuzura ikagera mu kanwa kayo ntiyabyitaho.

24.text: Mbese hari uwayifata iri maso,Cyangwa agapfumuza izuru ryayo ikigobwe?

25.text: “Mbese wabasha kurobesha Lewiyatani ururobo,Cyangwa gufatisha ururimi rwayo umugozi?

26.text: Washobora gushyira umugozi mu izuru ryayo,Cyangwa gutoboza akasaya kayo ururobo?

27.text: Mbese yagutakira cyane,Cyangwa yakubwira amagambo ashyeshya,

28.text: Aho yasezerana nawe,Kugira ngo ikubere umugaragu iminsi yose?

29.text: Wayikinisha nk'ukinisha inyoni?Cyangwa wayizirikira gusetsa abaja bawe?

31.text: Cyo ye wabasha kuzuza uruhu rwayo imyambi,Cyangwa umutwe wayo ibigobe?

32.text: Kuyibangurira ukuboko,Wibuke ko ari intambara ukugerure.
